summary: Verified the duplicate-detection removal in POST /api/import/loans-excel. Backend: 3/3 pytest cases pass — first import of a 3-row Excel (TestDupA x2, TestDupB x1, Status=Pending, month=Sep-2026) returns imported=3 / skipped=0 / duplicates=0 / total_rows=3 / errors=[]; re-importing the SAME file again returns imported=3 / skipped=0 / duplicates=0 (no duplicate blocking); GET /api/loans then shows all 6 rows (4x TestDupA, 2x TestDupB) with month=group_month='Sep-2026', status='Pending' and no MongoDB _id leakage. UI: admin login -> Month MIS -> Add Month (Sep-2026) -> Import Excel -> Sep-2026 selected -> upload xlsx -> toast reads 'Import complete! Imported: 3, Skipped: 0' and the Sep-2026 group shows 3 rows (TestDupA, TestDupA, TestDupB) with TOTAL (3). Cleanup completed: all 9 QA loans (6 API + 3 UI) deleted; 0 remaining.

ui_bugs.issue: First click on a collapsed month header often does not expand it - a second click is required. Cause: fetchLoans() unconditionally does setExpandedMonths(new Set([data[0].month])) on every refetch, which overwrites the user's toggleMonth state (race after load/import). Also conflicts with the 'collapsed by default' intent.

issues: React a11y console warning on every dialog: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' (Import/Add Month dialogs)

action_items: Optional: stop resetting expandedMonths inside fetchLoans (only auto-expand on initial load) so the first header click expands reliably.
Optional: remove now-unused locals customer_name/contact_no/bank in import_loans_from_excel (dead code left after duplicate-detection removal).
Optional: 'Add Month' empty group is client-state only; after import it persists via loans, but an empty month group disappears on reload.
critical_code_review_comments: import_loans_from_excel still returns 'duplicates' key hard-coded to 0 - keep for FE compatibility (FE reads response.data.duplicates) but consider documenting it.
server.py is very large (>2200 lines); consider splitting routers into modules.
seed_data_creation: Temporary Sep-2026 loans (TestDupA x4, TestDupB x2 via API + 3 via UI) - all deleted after testing (verified 0 remaining).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Duplicate-name import fix verified end-to-end. Reusable pytest: /app/backend/tests/test_import_duplicates_allowed.py (self-cleaning). Note: month group headers may need two clicks to expand because fetchLoans resets expandedMonths; account for this in Playwright scripts.
rca_of_the_issue: Original 'Imported: 0, Skipped: 17' was caused by the dup_query/find_one/continue block in import_loans_from_excel skipping every row that matched an existing customer. That block is now removed, so all rows with a non-empty customer_name are inserted; confirmed by importing the same file twice with imported=3 each time.
